LanguageData.RWS_VreLycanthrope_MorphsDesc: Counts completed player Lycanthrope form transitions (manual or condition-triggered), broken down by resulting xenotype. Reversions to an unidentified custom xenotype count in the total only.
LanguageData.RWS_VreLycanthrope_GermlineReimplantsDes: Counts committed Lycanthrope germline reimplantations or absorptions involving a player pawn that altered genes, xenotype, or applied endogermination coma.
LanguageData.RWS_VreFungoid_InfectionConversionsDesc: Counts living colonists, slaves, and prisoners whose Fungoid gene infection completed conversion.
LanguageData.RWS_VreInsector_GenelineEvolutionsDesc: Counts living player Insector pawns that completed a metapod evolution or geneline change.
LanguageData.RWS_VreInsector_GenelineReversionsDesc: Counts living player Insector pawns that completed a metapod reversion back to their baseline genetics.
LanguageData.RWS_AlphaAnimals_CocoonMetamorphosesDesc: Counts player Alpha Animals larvae or swarmlings that actually completed metamorphosis into a cocoon, by cocoon type.
LanguageData.RWS_AlphaAnimals_CocoonHatchesDesc: Counts living player black insectoids that actually emerged from hatched Alpha Animals cocoons, by animal kind.
LanguageData.RWS_VreSanguophage_DraincasketHemogenDes: Total hemogen units actually accepted by the hemogen pipe storage network from player Draincaskets.
